title: Finite subsets and finite colourings
proposed_reference_coverage: **Finite subsets and finite colourings: counting and bounds**
fact_or_context_to_reference: An r-element set has exactly 2^r subsets; its fixed-size subsets form a finite set. There are k^q maps from a q-element domain to k colours. The partition entry supplies the finite counting needed for its length-tagged colouring tree. A list of n distinct propositional atoms has exactly 2^n assignments to two truth values, including one empty assignment; the propositional entry proves this by doubling.
